variants.label: Full
variants.body:
Shipped: table areas on the booking page, live since 2026-07-14, guests pick window, terrace or bar when they book ([[tickets/jira/GST-140]]); one reminder per booking whatever the source, fixed 2026-07-17 after four support tickets ([[tickets/jira/BOK-412]]).
Changed: no-show fees is now aimed at end of October, told to Brasserie Lund on 2026-07-16 ([[customers/brasserie-lund]]); the stories go to sprint planning on 2026-07-22 ([[tickets/jira/BOK-300]]).

input.body:
## 2026-07-17

Table areas. Guests can pick a table area (window, terrace or bar) when they book. Name your areas once, and the booking list shows the area next to the table. A restaurant with no areas set sees no change.

One reminder for Google bookings. Guests who book through Google now get one reminder, the day before.

Source: weekly update, 2026-07-17
input.rationale: This week's section for the public Changelog: the two things a restaurant can use now. Plain words, no ticket keys, no customer names, no target dates, because every restaurant reads this page.
